label: rem:compound-beta-shell-calibration-key-distinction
title: Magic-crossing Q-value measures the difference of shell operators
html:
Non-magic vs magic \beta-decays (key distinction).

For magic-crossing decays, the \mathcal{Q}_q-value measures the strict difference in shell-operator contributions between parent and daughter, never the absolute shell magnitude itself. The parent intrinsically carries \sigma_{\mathrm{shell}}. The daughter realizes a distinct shell operator or a cross-shell transition.
